value: **Direct Callouts & Context**: "Findings show that (1) improvements in learning processes and outcomes occurring during simulation-based learning do not happen automatically just as a learner is confronted with a diagnostic task, but because learners engage in diagnostic activities during the diagnostic process; (2) facilitating this engagement can be facilitated through providing authentic and engaging tasks in different contexts, as well as personalized scaffolding." | "Furthermore, simulations also allow providing various forms of scaffolding (Fischer et al." | "To what extent does scaffolding moderate the effects of simulation -based learning on learning processes and outcomes in developing diagnostic skills?"
